content_sections.heading: About IISc Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bengaluru operates its Human Resources Section to manage temporary staffing requirements for specialized campus units such as the J.R.D Tata Memorial Library. This recruitment aims to engage qualified trainees to support library functions, emerging tools, and research services under a temporary contract structure.

rows.details: Library and Information Management (LIM) Project Trainee

content_sections.heading: Seats by Trade
content_sections.text: The recruitment offers 07 positions for Library and Information Management (LIM) Project Trainee in the J.R.D Tata Memorial Library.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Maximum 26 years as on the last date of receipt of the application. Age relaxation as per GoI norms (if applicable) will be extended. The candidate must be a citizen of India.

rows.qualification_required: - Bachelor’s degree in any discipline with a minimum of second class.- Masters in Library and Information Science (MLISc) or equivalent, passed out in the year 2025 or 2026 with first class.- Candidates who have appeared for their final-year MLISc examination and are expecting their results before the date of the written test and interview may also apply. However, such candidates must produce final marks sheet at the time of the written test and interview as proof of having passed the examination with First Class. Candidates who fail to produce the required proof of having secured First Class Will not be shortlisted for the written test.

content_sections.heading: Stipend and Training Period
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated emolument of Rs. 25,000/- + HRA per month. Engagement is purely temporary on a contract basis for a period of 2 years. For candidates previously employed at IISc through appointments made by the HR Department, the duration of their prior service will be counted in the maximum permissible tenure of two years. An increment of up to 10% is admissible in the case of extension, based on the performance of the candidate and the recommendation of the Competent Authority.

content_sections.heading: IISc Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The traineeship provides an opportunity to gain practical experience while working across various functions and services of the library, with focus on emerging tools and technologies. Trainees will assist in the acquitision of print and digital content; classification, cataloguing, and organization of information resources; circulation and reference services; document delivery; and research support services. Trainees will work six days a week on a rotational shift basis, including holidays, as per the library’s operational requirements.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IISc Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who are desirous to be considered strictly on the aforesaid terms and conditions may fill out the application form on the link given below duly attaching the required certificates in support of age, category, qualification, and marks on or before 19.11.2026. No hardcopy submission of the online submitted application is accepted. However, candidates are advised to keep a printout of the online application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Based on the number of applications received, the written test may be conducted only for shortlisting the candidates. The final selection will be based on the candidate’s performance in the interview.
